# Instructions for AI coding assistants

Read [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root. It has the design
philosophy (the agents are in charge: give them capabilities, never script
outcomes), how to run the sim, how every change must be verified
(`pytest` and `scripts/sim_check.py`), the architecture map, known gotchas and
the current open issues.

The older guide that used to be here described files that no longer exist; it
is in git history.
